title: GET EVERYTHING FOR FREE
script:
local run = true

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.01) do
        if run then
            pcall(function()
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                    .Packages._Index["sleitnick_knit@1.5.1"]
                    .knit.Services.GiftService.RF.GetPresent:InvokeServer("Present")
            end)
            pcall(function()
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                    .Packages._Index["sleitnick_knit@1.5.1"]
                    .knit.Services.GiftService.RF.GetPresent:InvokeServer("SuperPresent")
            end)
        end
    end
end)

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if not gpe and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B then
        run = not run
        print("Toggled:", run)
    end
end)
